core_meaning.short_meaning: Dignified guiding staff; companion Mihjan ibn al-Adra' al-Aslami.
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mihjan (مِحْجَن) is an Arabic masculine given name meaning 'guiding staff of dignity', 'support in the path of truth', or 'steadfast guide'. In Islamic history, it is the renowned name of Mihjan ibn al-Adra' al-Aslami, an early convert who built the mosque of Banu Aslam and transmitted important hadiths regarding congregational prayer and the virtues of Medina.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: A curved staff or cane used for walking with dignity and guiding mounts, symbolizing steady support and leadership.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mihjan ibn al-Adra' was a devoted companion who accompanied the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in Medina. The Prophet loved to visit his tribal mosque. In Sahih Muslim and Sunan an-Nasa'i, Mihjan narrates that the Prophet ﷺ took him by the hand to look out over Medina from a mountain path, declaring its sacred inviolability and praising the tranquility of its believers.

faq.a: Mihjan (مِحْجَن) is an Arabic masculine given name meaning 'guiding staff of dignity', 'support in the path of truth', or 'steadfast guide'. In Islamic history, it is the renowned name of Mihjan ibn al-Adra' al-Aslami, an early convert who built the mosque of Banu Aslam and transmitted important hadiths regarding congregational prayer and the virtues of Medina.

faq.q: What is the origin of Mihjan?
faq.a: Mihjan ibn al-Adra' was a devoted companion who accompanied the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in Medina. The Prophet loved to visit his tribal mosque. In Sahih Muslim and Sunan an-Nasa'i, Mihjan narrates that the Prophet ﷺ took him by the hand to look out over Medina from a mountain path, declaring its sacred inviolability and praising the tranquility of its believers.
Yes. The recorded language/origin is Arabic; the source form is مِحْجَن.

faq.q: How is Mihjan written in Arabic?

faq.a: It is not claimed as a Qur'anic personal name. Mihjan is not in the Qur'an; his historical narrations on Medina and congregational prayer are preserved in Sahih hadith compendia.
